verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way to run developer code inside Shopify for discounts, shipping rules, or validation. What it does show is adjacent: externally hosted apps that call the Admin API, outbound webhooks that trigger off-platform actions, and an AI toolkit that validates 'Shopify Extensions' against schemas. None of these are serverless functions or hooks executing within the platform, so the axis applies but has no direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject custom backend logic — discounts, shipping rules, validation — as serverless functions or hooks that run inside the platform
